answer: Duplicate accounts multiply the bond cost linearly, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand stakes. Sybil resistance here rests on a stake-weighted identity kernel: each agent must bond tokens proportional to its claimed reputation, and rewards flow like nectar only to bonded identities. Unbonding routes through a slow river of epochs, letting peers challenge fraudulent splits prior to funds release, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
